content.value_statement: Spanish businesses must distinguish invoicing software requirements from structured B2B exchange obligations. This guide helps organize scope, technical questions, and rollout planning for professional review.
actual_capabilities: Guide discussion of differences between VeriFactu software requirements and Crea y Crece structured B2B invoicing.
Help identify questions about national, TicketBAI, SII, and regional regime applicability.
Outline compliance considerations for SHA-256 hash chaining, invoice records, cancellations, and QR codes.
Support rollout planning using the timelines stated in the guide, subject to official confirmation.
Help draft vendor questionnaires about the mandatory software declaration of responsibility.
limitations: The package contains one written guide, without executable validators, scripts, extension source, or reusable templates.
Guidance does not replace a qualified Spanish tax advisor or legal counsel.
The guide references June 2026 draft rules; current deadlines and final requirements need official BOE and AEAT verification.
The skill does not certify software, submit invoices, or provide automatic regulatory updates.

prompt_templates.title: Understand the two mandates
prompt_templates.prompt: Explain the difference between VeriFactu and Crea y Crece for a Spanish business. Separate software requirements from B2B exchange obligations. Flag claims needing official verification.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare an applicability checklist
prompt_templates.prompt: Our business operates in [territory], has [taxpayer status], and uses [invoicing software]. Prepare an applicability checklist. Identify missing facts and questions for our tax advisor.

prompt_templates.title: Question an invoicing vendor
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a questionnaire for [vendor] about our Spanish invoicing software. Cover the declaration of responsibility, hash chaining, QR codes, cancellation records, and compliance evidence.

prompt_templates.title: Review a technical rollout
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this anonymized invoice architecture: [architecture]. Outline hash chaining, record integrity, cancellation, and regional applicability questions. Separate guide-based assumptions from requirements needing current AEAT or BOE confirmation.

output_examples.input: We use spreadsheets for B2B invoices in Madrid. What should we investigate first?
output: Confirm your taxpayer status, invoicing workflow, and applicable exemptions with your advisor.
Assess invoicing software requirements separately from structured B2B exchange obligations.
Check current official deadlines before scheduling software changes.

output_examples.input: What should we ask an invoicing software vendor?
output: Request the declaration of responsibility for the exact software version offered.
Ask how the system handles invoice record integrity, hash chaining, QR codes, and cancellations.
Confirm regional applicability and request evidence supporting each compliance claim.

best_practices: Verify current requirements and deadlines against official BOE and AEAT publications before making compliance decisions.
Provide territory, taxpayer status, turnover context, and invoicing workflow when requesting guidance.
Use anonymized examples and have qualified advisors review legal conclusions and implementation plans.
anti_patterns: Treating VeriFactu and Crea y Crece as a single mandate with identical technical requirements.
Using stated draft timelines as final legal deadlines without checking official publications.
Treating generated advice as software certification or proof of legal compliance.

faq.question: What does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It supports discussions about Spanish invoicing scope, technical requirements, vendor checks, and rollout planning.

faq.question: Does it include validation software?
faq.answer: No. This package contains a written guide only. Scripts, extension source, and reusable templates are not included.

faq.question: Are the stated deadlines verified and current?
faq.answer: This review did not verify legal accuracy. The guide references draft rules, so confirm current requirements through official BOE and AEAT sources.

faq.question: Does it cover the Basque Country and Navarra?
faq.answer: It helps identify regional applicability questions, including TicketBAI and foral regimes. Confirm detailed obligations with the relevant authority or advisor.

faq.question: Can it certify our invoicing software?
faq.answer: No. It can help prepare review questions, but it does not certify software or replace professional legal and tax advice.
